WITH DepOutBal AS (
SELECT AccountSK, AccountID, SUM(BalanceAmountFull)/27 AS MTDADB FROM dw.FactDepositsOutstandingBalance_TEST_20231010 
    WHERE BusinessDateSK >= 20230101 AND BusinessDateSK <= 20230127
    AND AccountID IN (SELECT AccountID FROM dw.FactDepositsOutstandingBalance_TEST_20231010 WHERE BusinessDateSK = 20230127)
    AND AccountID IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY AccountSK, AccountID
)
SELECT 
    ---COUNT(*)
    TOP 50
    A.*
    ,B.BusinessDateSK,B.AccountSK, B.AccountId, B.AverageDailBalanceAmountMTDFulll
    FROM (SELECT * FROM DepOutBal) A
    FULL OUTER JOIN (SELECT * FROM DW.FactAverageDailyBalanceMTD_TEST_20231012 WHERE BusinessDateSK = 20230127 AND AccountID IS NOT NULL) B ON B.AccountSK = A.AccountSK
    WHERE ISNULL(A.MTDADB,0) != ISNULL(B.AverageDailBalanceAmountMTDFulll,0)

SELECT * FROM DW.FactAverageDailyBalanceMTD_TEST_20231012 WHERE BusinessDateSK = 20230126 AND AccountID IS NULL
